Subject: Sales discovery: FinLytics integration - 5xx during embed/reranker requests (post-call recap & next steps)

Hi Alex - great call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Recap:
- You saw intermittent 5xx responses when calling our embeddings -> reranker pipeline from your staging environment (request id examples: r-01A2B3C4).
- These occur most frequently on larger batched payloads (50-100 documents) or when using the client SDK with the default timeout.
- Your current integration uses the Redwood JS SDK (v1.6.0) with API key auth routed through your proxy.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you share one full failing request payload + the SDK request logs (headers + body)? I've created repro-steps.txt to capture what we need - attaching that.
2) Please try a quick client-side timeout bump to 120s and reduce batch size to 20 - this helps us distinguish timeouts vs server 5xx.
3) Dev team to try the same payload via curl/POST to our endpoint (attach redwood-req-sample.json).
4) If you can share logs.zip with the full server-side trace, we'll triage on infra and routing.

Internal owners: Dev (Dev Patel) will take lead on repro and initial debugging; Camila will own the integration-side notes and postmortem.

I'll attached: repro-steps.txt and a sample request JSON. If you can send sdk-req.log that will speed things up.

Thanks - aiming for a repro and initial root-cause by EOD tomorrow PST.

- Marissa

Subject: Re: Sales discovery: FinLytics integration - 5xx during embed/reranker requests (post-call recap & next steps)

Hi Alex - thanks for the logs, that was super helpful. Quick notes from an initial pass: 

- The 500s align with an internal KV cache eviction path when the sequence+context size spikes - we see larger token counts in the failing payloads (example in redwood-req-sample.json).
- There are two hypotheses: (A) request payload tokenization pushes an internal buffer > configured limit causing an uncaught exception, or (B) a routing/proxy timeout between the SDK and our edge causing the request to be retried/failed.

Immediate repro steps I recommend you try (simple, local):
1) Reduce batch size to 20 (as Marissa suggested) and set client timeout = 120s.
2) If still failing, run the same payload via curl directly against the same region endpoint (skip your proxy) - this will isolate proxy issues. Example curl in repro-steps.txt.
3) If curl also fails, send the exact failing request id(s) and we'll pull server traces (I'll open INF-4987 and attach traces once we have ids).

Config recommendations we'll try on our side: increase the internal chunk timeout for the reranker worker from 60s -> 90s for the staging pool, and add a guard for large payloads to return 413 with an explicit message rather than 500.

I'll take the initial server traces once you confirm the failing request ids. 

- Dev

- Attached repro-steps.txt (we followed your curl example) and sdk-req.log (from our staging run).

Next: please open INF-4987 and attach server traces for r-01A2B3C4/r-01A2B3D8 and we'll review. Also let us know if a temporary config bump on your staging pool (chunk timeout) would help - we can hold off production until root cause is clear.
